sectors.trend: Iron ore under pressure ('roaches seethe'); gold and copper-PGE exploration positive with Forrestania, Aurum, Dalaroo pipeline. LNG exports to Japan strong.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face near-term iron ore headwinds. Gold miners (Nevada Gold, Aurum) and copper names benefit from exploration upside. Woodside (WDS.AX) supported by LNG demand.

sectors.trend: Big four banks advance as oil prices and bond yields ease. RBA hawkish but at 'sensible level'. State interest costs soaring. Qantas strike risk.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX benefit from stable rate environment and easing yields. Credit risk monitored via Qantas (QAN.AX) strike and state debt.

sectors.trend: Petrol price shock and Middle East oil shock elevate inflation risk. Victoria backs away from renewable transmission. Federal coal policy shift.
sectors.implications: Oil price volatility supports Woodside (WDS.AX), Santos (STO.AX) short-term but renewable retreat hurts AGL.AX, Origin (ORG.AX) transition narratives.

sectors.trend: Coles maintains higher milk prices despite axing farmer support. Housing 'absurdly unaffordable'. Immigration restrictions hit regional businesses.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WBC.AX (retail) face margin pressure. REITs (GPW.AX, SPG.AX) pressured by affordability and tenant relief. Working-holiday visa cuts hit tourism/consumer sectors.

sectors.trend: Anthropic $31bn Queensland data centre deal; ASX small-caps Latrobe, CurveBeam, Arrow, Sultan lead weekly gains.
sectors.implications: Data centre build-out supports construction and power demand. Small-cap momentum in tech/energy names. Limited direct ASX 200 impact but positive for infrastructure spend.

sectors.trend: No major ASX healthcare headlines today. Flu season awareness noted.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX, XRO.AX trade on global pharma/medical device trends; no specific catalyst today.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA further rate hike / IMF fiscal tightening
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration in rate-sensitive REITs and growth equities; favour dividend-paying financials and staples.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Fed rate hike and global risk-off
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge AUD exposure; monitor AUD/USD; favour domestic-revenue-heavy ASX names over export-dependent.
Underweight BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX near-term; rotate into gold and copper exploration plays.
Increase allocation to defensive staples (WES.AX, WBC.AX), healthcare (CSL.AX), and cash.
Avoid QAN.AX ahead of strike; monitor travel and tourism-linked names.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Middle East oil shock / petrol prices
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour upstream energy (WDS.AX, STO.AX); avoid transport and logistics exposure.
Selective REIT exposure only; favour industrial and healthcare REITs over residential.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and copper exploration names on WA pipeline
opportunities.rationale: Forrestania prefeasibility, Aurum Côte d'Ivoire discovery, Dalaroo PGE targets create near-term catalysts; gold benefits from Fed-driven safe-haven flows.

opportunities.recommendation: Maintain overweight on big four banks
opportunities.rationale: Banks advanced on easing yields; RBA at 'sensible level' supports NIM stability; dividend yield attractive.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective energy exposure on LNG and oil upside
opportunities.rationale: Japan LNG demand surge and Middle East oil shock support upstream; petrol prices lift exploration spend.

opportunities.recommendation: Monitor Anthropic/Queensland data centre for infrastructure beneficiaries
opportunities.rationale: $31bn data centre deal drives construction, power, and telecom demand in WA/Qld.

defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore under pressure; China demand concerns; rotate into gold/copper.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim residential REITs and rate-sensitive growth
defensive_moves.rationale: Housing 'absurdly unaffordable', RBA hike risk, and state interest costs rising pressure valuations.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid Qantas and travel-linked names pre-strike
defensive_moves.rationale: Ground staff strike over Joyce-era agreements creates near-term operational and earnings risk.
Recession odds rising, Fed hike, RBA hawkish – preserve capital for 2027 risk.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain volatile and range-bound. RBA decision and Fed hike dominate. Banks and energy provide support; iron ore and REITs drag. Qantas strike adds idiosyncratic risk. Expect 1–2% index volatility weekly.
market_outlook.long_term: 2027 recession probability rising is the key overhang. Housing affordability, state debt, and immigration tightening constrain consumption. Mining rotation from iron ore to gold/copper/LNG supports selectivity. Data centre build-out and infrastructure spend offer medium-term growth pockets. Structural headwinds to consumer spending persist.
